project_info.theme: Miniature crew builds a mobile food-ordering catalogue
project_info.color_palette: Cream, fast-food red, warm yellow, brushed silver, cola brown

main_subject.detail: A giant vertical smartphone stands at a slight three-quarter angle on a glossy studio floor; its shopping UI becomes four deep physical display alcoves containing fries, onion rings, cola, and a burger, tended by four realistic miniature workers.

composition_elements.text: MENU; TASTY BITE; DEALS; Golden French Fries; Crispy Onion Rings; Ice Cold Cola; Double Cheeseburger
items: Top: yellow app header with MENU, TASTY BITE and DEALS.
Two-by-two screen recesses: fries, onion rings, cola and burger products with product title, ratings and review counts.
Left: worker on ladder adjusts fries; lower left worker kneels with cleaning tool.
Right: worker hangs from rope to adjust onion rings; lower right worker lifts oversized burger.
Bottom: red UI navigation, white icons and cart badge 1.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Deep physical UI shadows, crisp food texture, realistic clothing creases and polished floor reflections

assets.name: app UI and food product references
assets.source: approved app screens and food packshots
assets.usage: Preserve app header, icon system, product names, packaging and food appearance.

assets.name: mobile commerce interface
assets.usage: Keep navigation, cart badge and product grid hierarchy accurate.

assets.name: miniature worker styling
assets.usage: Use generic photoreal workers with consistent scale; do not copy real people.

prompt_instructions: Attach current UI and product references before rendering.
Make the four workers photorealistic humans at one matching miniature scale, not dolls.
Keep each food item tangibly recessed into the screen surface.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic 3D commercial photograph of a giant smartphone standing vertically on a [FLOOR MATERIAL: e.g., grey concrete, polished marble, dark reflective] studio floor. The phone is viewed from a slight 3/4 perspective angle to emphasize depth. The Concept: The screen acts as a [STYLE ADJECTIVE: e.g., luxury, high-tech, heated] physical display cabinet with four deep, recessed alcoves arranged in a 2x2 grid. The products are tangible, volumetric 3D objects sitting inside these slots, flush with the screen's surface, casting real, deep shadows into the UI background. UI Details ([THEME NAME] Theme): Theme: The App UI uses a [COLOR PALETTE: e.g., Black & Gold, Red & Yellow] aesthetic. Top: SORT left, FILTER right, [BRAND NAME] center. Bottom Nav: Icons are [ICON COLOR]. Shopping Cart has a small red notification badge showing the number 1. The Crew: Four photorealistic, lifelike miniature humans dressed in [UNIFORM DESCRIPTION]. Their skin has texture, pores, sweat, and realistic imperfections; clothing has creases and signs of wear; all share identical miniature scale. Top-left slot contains [PRODUCT A]; Worker 1 adjusts it from a [LADDER TYPE] ladder. Top-right slot contains [PRODUCT B]; Worker 2 hangs by a [ROPE TYPE] and works on it. Bottom-left contains [PRODUCT C]; Worker 3 kneels with a [PROP] and directs the team. Bottom-right is empty but shows [PRODUCT D NAME] and reviews; Worker 4 struggles to lift the heavy fallen [PRODUCT D OBJECT]. Background: [BACKGROUND TYPE]. [LIGHTING STYLE] lighting highlights [SPECIFIC TEXTURES]. 8k resolution, Octane render style.
prompt.negative_prompt: plastic doll workers, flat screen UI, non-recessed products, distorted food, incorrect UI icons, extra workers, low detail, watermark
